originalAlarm.description: Null pointer passed to 2nd parameter expecting 'nonnull'

reasoning: TRUE POSITIVE: When ENABLE_FEATURE_MODPROBE_MULTIPLE_OPTIONS is false, the #else branch compiles in 'strcat(buf, dt)' at line 21. 'dt' is initialized to NULL and only conditionally set to '-i' (when rand()%2). When dt remains NULL, strcat(buf, NULL) passes a null pointer to strcat's 2nd parameter which expects non-null — a genuine null dereference. KNOWN BUG: The vbdb entry for 199501f2a00.c documents exactly this NullDereference bug at the same location and same config condition (!FEATURE_MODPROBE_MULTIPLE_OPTIONS). The tool is detecting the same bug. CORRECTLY CONSTRAINED: ENABLE_FEATURE_MODPROBE_MULTIPLE_OPTIONS==false is correct — the strcat call is in the #else branch (disabled when the feature is on), and the null-check guard is only in the #ifdef branch.
